1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2024

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion sembilan ratus

lima puluh tiga juta tiga ratus lapan puluh lapan ribu ringgit (RM1,953,388,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2024 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan

bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 361,934,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 332,851,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 89,263,000

Perbelanjaan lain 176,382,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 992,958,000

JUMLAH 1,953,388,000

Dibuat 7 Februari 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(33); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2024

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion nine hundred and fifty-three million

three hundred and eighty-eight thousand ringgit (RM1,953,388,000)

from the Social Security Fund for the expenditure on administration

of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2024 is hereby authorized

for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 361,934,000

Supplies and services 332,851,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 89,263,000

Other expenditures 176,382,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 992,958,000

TOTAL 1,953,388,000

Made 7 February 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(33); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

 Minister of Human Resources
